review_scope: Independent read-only review of the neutral standalone calculator baseline, contract, execution ledger/archive/replay, initializers, storage, CLI/HTTP/UI, hand-calculable witnesses and publication evidence.
method: Read source, tests, browser driver and generated verification artifacts; manually derive the exact six-layout front of the 16-layout tiny instance; inspect the 1440px browser screenshot. Reviewer did not edit product/source files or independently execute the test suite. Automated execution evidence was generated by the implementation runner and independently inspected.

resolved_findings.finding: Greedy acceptance assumed the final objective was cost.
resolved_findings.resolution: Performance axes are selected by objective ID; reordered and cost-omitted objective regressions are present.

resolved_findings.finding: Finite large point weights could overflow their sum and silently produce zero coverage.
resolved_findings.resolution: Weights are scaled by their maximum before normalization; 1e308 weight witness passes.

resolved_findings.finding: GET lacked loopback Host validation, permitting DNS-rebinding reads.
resolved_findings.resolution: GET now validates Host; hostile Host regression is included.

resolved_findings.finding: Exact/local diagnostics could silently omit evaluator ValueError failures.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only structural installation rejection is skipped; actual evaluator errors propagate, with a deliberate-failure regression.
Terminal status, completed checkpoint count, per-generation population size, row generation and provenance are checked and mutation-tested.

resolved_findings.finding: Map selection could remain on a row hidden by the displayed Hamming subset, and the legend hardcoded A/B/C.
resolved_findings.resolution: Selection follows actual displayed rows and the legend is generated from the displayed contract.

independent_witness.instance: tests/test_contract.py tiny(): two sites, two sensor types, two weighted points; all 16 layouts feasible.
independent_witness.conclusion: The analytic union, joint coverage and shared activation-cost accounting match the explicit contract. The six-member finite front is distinct from the observed optimizer archive; the optimizer is not assumed to discover every reference member.

observed_evidence.browser: Real Edge: parameter edit, MOEA, save, export, restart, restore, replay and stop; exact normal/enlarged map DOM assertion; no page errors.
observed_evidence.installed_wheel: Temporary venv package import, MOEA/replay and web assets passed using existing host dependencies.
observed_evidence.source_preservation: 11352 pre-snapshotted source/text files and exact Git porcelain status unchanged within the declared exclusions.
observed_evidence.publication_scan: 47 selected source/doc/test/root files checked, no sensitive matches; token-boundary scanner includes positive/negative self-check.
observed_evidence.lineage: Five neutral modules retain source and target byte hashes with LF/trailing-blank normalization; six named inventory functions have explicit lineage.

limitations: PASS approves the bounded reusable baseline reviewed here; GitHub publication and remote SHA verification remain the parent task's separate responsibility.
New coverage/resource model is synthetic and uses XY sample coverage plus explicit solid-prism LOS; field validity and human usability are not measured.
Browser layer/filter/checkpoint interactions are smoke coverage; they are not exhaustive UI or human-comprehension validation.
Installed-wheel verification reused host dependency packages; a network-clean dependency installation and the configured CI matrix were not independently observed.
Exact reference applies only to the finite frozen tiny discretization; larger-instance global optimality is not certified.
Source preservation excludes the large/imported/runtime trees declared in source-preservation.json; reviewer did not independently rehash those excluded trees.
Review does not guarantee absence of every defect or constitute a security penetration test.

followup_review.conclusion: Independent git diff review confirmed that six extracted modules changed only by removing trailing blank lines; no Python statements changed. Full normalized-source tests/browser/wheel/preservation were rerun, publication scan resumed with corrected token boundaries, and final manifest/evidence file hashes refreshed.
